Pulse for 8 October 2026

The stories from 8 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Study

AI talks to patients first

AMIE is a research chatbot from Google that asks patients about their symptoms, and a study in The Lancet tested it with real patients before their doctor visits.

Everyday tool

Ask Claude for a dashboard

Claude Dashboards is a new Claude feature that turns a plain-language question about company data into a live page of charts, and Anthropic launched it in beta on October 8, 2026.

New model

Coding AI up to 8x faster

Ultrafast is a faster mode of OpenAI's model GPT-6.1 Sol, and OpenAI says it is rolling out in the API, in Codex and in ChatGPT Work.

AI agents

Gemini becomes a coworker

An agent is a piece of software that takes a goal and works through the steps with tools, and Google's new Gemini agent is meant to do that work inside a company.

Everyday tool

Claude bans cruelty to AI

A usage policy is the rulebook for what you may do with a product, and Anthropic published a yearly update for Claude that takes effect on November 12, 2026.

Everyday tool

AI notes that work offline

Google AI Edge Foresight is an experimental note-taking app that transcribes meetings on a Mac without sending the audio to the internet.

Device

Alexa explains your screen

On-Screen Intelligence is a feature on Amazon's new Alexa tablets that lets the Alexa+ assistant look at the screen and answer questions about what is there.

Study

AI now helps build AI

The State of AI Report is a yearly overview of AI by investor Nathan Benaich and Air Street Capital, and its 2026 edition says AI now does a real share of the work of building AI.
